content.text: The guard compares the user id with the role. The JWT payload has a `role` field, so I'll check that.

candidates.explanation: The guard checks whether the required roles include the authenticated user's id (`request.user?.id`) instead of the user's role id (`request.user?.role?.id`). The seeded super admin has id 1, which equals RoleEnum.admin (1), so it passes. Every later admin has a different user id, so it fails and gets 403.

fix.description: Compare against the user's role id, not the user id.
